confidence: Low. Artie has the sharpest explicit motive; several others have motives or potential means, but no actual death or individual poison-handling timeline is released.
plausibility_notes: Concrete museum documents establish credible donor coercion and provenance stakes.
Authentic retained poison is hazardous, but Grant insisting on it and a conservator refusing approval make the setup coherent within a scripted mystery.
Mount closure, canceled blackout, separate camera circuit, and surviving private toast establish usable timeline constraints, though they require careful tracking.
The manager who collects the presentation glass is ambiguous: the relevant manager has not yet been identified.
Unsigned warning cannot reliably identify an activist; draft agreements and proof documents establish plans, not completed acts.
